title: When the Scholarship Breaks
author: Sable Kavanagh
blurb: Felix Eriksen, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
